title: Gold kharidte waqt ye 3 galtiyan kaunsi hain?
hooks: Gold kharidne ja rahe ho? Ye 3 galtiyan aapka paisa kha jaati hain.
Sona khareedne se pehle ye 3 cheezein check kar liya karo.
Jeweller aapko ye 3 baatein kabhi nahi batayega. Khud check karo.
hook_why: Mistake-warning hook with direct address and loss framing matches the channel's top-performing pattern; first 6 words carry the threat and the topic.
metaphor: Phone screen as the buyer's dashboard: every rule, bill and check happens on the device the viewer already holds.
mechanism: Buyer opens BIS Care app and scans 6-digit HUID to verify hallmark authenticity
Buyer reads bill: GST 3% applies on total value (gold + making + hallmark charges), not just gold
Buyer negotiates making charges (percentage or per-gram) before finalising the bill

caption:
Gold kharidne ja rahe ho? Ye 3 galtiyan aapka paisa kha jaati hain.

1. HUID scan kiye bina hallmark mat maano — BIS Care app pe verify karo (BIS circular, 1 Apr 2023).
2. GST 3% poore bill value pe lagta hai, making charge pe bhi (CBIC clarification).
3. Making charge negotiate karo — jeweller decide karta hai, bill me alag-alag dikhna chahiye.

Save karo, kaam aayega. Aapne kab last time HUID check kiya? Comment karo.

Source: BIS circular 2021/2023, CBIC GST clarification

claims.claim: Hallmarking of gold jewellery is mandatory in India from 2021.
Every hallmarked piece carries a 6-digit HUID since 1 April 2023.
Buyer can verify HUID on the BIS Care app (Verify HUID feature).
claims.basis: BIS Care app functionality, official BIS guidance

claims.claim: Items under 2 grams are exempt from mandatory hallmarking.
claims.basis: BIS exemption notification for articles under 2g

claims.claim: GST is 3% on the full invoice value of jewellery, including making charges and hallmark charges.
claims.basis: CBIC clarification on GST for jewellery

claims.claim: Making charges are set by the jeweller (often a percentage of gold value) and can be negotiated.
Bill should show weight, purity (22K = 916), rate per gram, making charge, hallmark charge and GST separately.

steps_learned: Scan the 6-digit HUID on the BIS Care app to verify the hallmarked gold.
Understand that 3% GST applies to the total bill value, including making charges.
Ensure the bill separately lists weight, purity (22K=916), rate, making charges, hallmark charges, and GST.
Negotiate the making charges with the jeweller.
missing_steps: The script mentions some items are exempt from HUID (e.g., under 2g), which is a crucial detail for a buyer to know so they don't get confused if a small item lacks it.
It doesn't explain *how* to negotiate making charges (e.g., comparing with other jewellers or checking the 'making charge' percentage).
